captions.start: Sit near the front of the chair

steps.text: Sit near the front of a firm chair. Feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, knees above your ankles.
Cross your arms over your chest if you can. Lean your chest forward a little.
Push through your heels and stand up tall. Straighten your hips and knees at the top.
Reach back for the chair and sit down slowly, taking about two seconds.

safety: Put the chair against a wall so it cannot slide.
If you need your hands to stand up safely, use them.
Stop if you feel dizzy or have pain in your knees.

mistakes.label: uncontrolled_sit
mistakes.wrong: you sat down too quickly instead of lowering yourself slowly
mistakes.right: Sit down slowly: reach back for the chair with your hands and lower yourself gently.

mistakes.label: feet_forward
mistakes.wrong: your feet were too far in front of you when you started to stand
mistakes.right: Bring your feet back so your knees are above your ankles before you stand.

setup: Put a firm chair side-on to the phone, with its back against a wall.
